art_direction.style_name: Playful Modern 2D Vector Illustration + Bold Editorial Advertising
art_direction.character_lock: Friendly Indian bakery shopkeeper with short black beard, white shirt, deep purple apron (#743BAA). Customer is Indian woman in mustard/orange top (#FEA711) with cream scarf.
art_direction.setting_lock: Artisanal neighborhood bakery with wooden shelves, golden breads, purple dome lamps, lavender walls (#F4EFFD), and pastry glass display.

scenes.action: Shopkeeper behind bakery counter holds up fresh croissant toward camera with an inviting smile.
scenes.voiceover: Got a product you want to sell fast today? Don't wait for foot traffic.
scenes.caption: Got a deal to share today?

scenes.action: First-person POV holding smartphone over bakery counter framing croissant display; camera autofocus box pulses and snaps photo.
scenes.voiceover: Open meelTe, tap the plus sign, and snap a clear photo.
scenes.caption: Tap + ➔ Single Item

scenes.action: Phone screen shows ad creation form; vibrant orange 'FLAT 25% OFF' badge springs onto the croissant photo, and map drops an orange pin.
scenes.camera: Smooth steady pan down form card.
scenes.voiceover: Add your price, pick your discount badge, and pin your store on the map.
scenes.caption: Pick your discount badge

scenes.action: Smiling shopkeeper hands brown bakery bag across counter to happy female customer in mustard top.
scenes.camera: Gentle lateral drift with green 'Advertisement created' notification overlay.
scenes.voiceover: Hit create! No waiting for approvals—your deal goes live to nearby shoppers right now.
scenes.caption: Instantly live to nearby neighbors!

scenes.action: Deep purple canvas (#743BAA), white meelTe wordmark, headline 'Grow your store free', vibrant orange CTA button 'Try meelTe free'.
scenes.camera: Locked frame with spring scale on logo and button.
scenes.voiceover: Put your shop on the map. Try meelTe free today!
scenes.caption: Grow your store free
